headline: DSK Legal advises Sigma Advanced Systems on ₹153 crore acquisition of Bromford Precision Solutions
sum: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited has made a 100% acquisition of Bromford Precision Solutions Limited, a UK-based manufacturer of high-precision aerospace components, through its wholly owned subsidiary in Sigma UK Limited, for ₹153 crore.…
detail: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited has made a 100% acquisition of Bromford Precision Solutions Limited, a UK-based manufacturer of high-precision aerospace components, through its wholly owned subsidiary in Sigma UK Limited, for ₹153 crore. DSK Legal advised Sigma Advanced Systems on this acquisition. The Firm assisted in reviewing and negotiating the Share Purchase Agreement; reviewing and negotiating the Agreements with Rolls Royce in connection with the transaction; assisting with the satisfaction of exchange and completion deliverables. The transaction team consisted of Vignesh Adithyan (Senior Associate) and Dheeraj Budaraju (Associate).
